why.title: Why ImmerQR
why.lede: Many free QR generators route your code through their own address. When the trial ends, the code stops working or ends up behind a paywall. An ImmerQR code holds your link itself, so there is nothing that can wilt.
why.them.title: Typical “dynamic” code
why.them.note: from a generator with a free trial
why.us.title: ImmerQR code
why.us.note: your link, written straight into the modules
why.us.4.what: Works, even if immerqr.de is gone
why.static.title: Static or dynamic?
why.static.p1: A static code stores the content itself, your link for example. Every phone reads it directly, without a detour through someone else's server. It works for as long as your target exists.
why.static.p2: A dynamic code only stores a short address of the provider, whose server then redirects. That allows statistics and later changes, but it ties your code to them: when the subscription or the service ends, so does the code.
why.static.p3: ImmerQR only makes static codes. If you want to change the target later, point the code at an address you own and redirect from there.
